title: Adding realistic reflections to an AR experience

segments.source: Adding realistic reflections to an AR experience
segments.ko: Adding realistic reflections to an AR experience

segments.source: **Framework**: ARKit
segments.ko: **Framework**: ARKit

segments.source: Use ARKit to generate environment probe textures from camera imagery and render reflective virtual objects.
segments.ko: Use ARKit to generate environment probe textures from camera imagery and render reflective virtual objects.

segments.source: **Availability**:
segments.ko: **Availability**:

segments.source: iPadOS 12.0+
segments.ko: iPadOS 12.0+

segments.source: Mac Catalyst 12.0+
segments.ko: Mac Catalyst 12.0+

segments.source: Xcode 16.0+
segments.ko: Xcode 16.0+

segments.source: Overview
segments.ko: Overview

segments.source: This app provides a simple AR experience demonstrating the environment texturing features in ARKit 2 and SceneKit.
segments.ko: This app provides a simple AR experience demonstrating the environment texturing features in ARKit 2 and SceneKit.

segments.source: After you build and run the app, explore your surroundings in the camera view.
segments.ko: After you build and run the app, explore your surroundings in the camera view.

segments.source: Then, tap a nearby horizontal surface to place a virtual object: a mirror-finish sphere.
segments.ko: Then, tap a nearby horizontal surface to place a virtual object: a mirror-finish sphere.

segments.source: After you place the object, you can drag it around or tap to move it to another location.
segments.ko: After you place the object, you can drag it around or tap to move it to another location.

segments.source: You can also pinch to make the object bigger or smaller.
segments.ko: You can also pinch to make the object bigger or smaller.

segments.source: ![Screenshots of the sample app, showing UI prompts for placing a virtual object, the shiny virtual sphere, and the virtual sphere showing the reflection of a real object.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/c91fbc006b62c26b4e97784ab5dddfc0/Screenshots.png)
segments.ko: ![Screenshots of the sample app, showing UI prompts for placing a virtual object, the shiny virtual sphere, and the virtual sphere showing the reflection of a real object.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/c91fbc006b62c26b4e97784ab5dddfc0/Screenshots.png)

segments.source: Notice the surface of the virtual sphere shows a generally realistic (if not perfectly accurate) reflection of its real-world surroundings.
segments.ko: Notice the surface of the virtual sphere shows a generally realistic (if not perfectly accurate) reflection of its real-world surroundings.

segments.source: To create reflective virtual surfaces, a renderer (such as SceneKit) needs an *environment texture*—an image that captures the view in all directions from a certain point in the scene (called an *environment probe*).
segments.ko: To create reflective virtual surfaces, a renderer (such as SceneKit) needs an *environment texture*—an image that captures the view in all directions from a certain point in the scene (called an *environment probe*).

segments.source: Realistically rendering reflections for multiple objects, or moving objects, may require multiple environment textures, each capturing the scene from a different point of view.
segments.ko: Realistically rendering reflections for multiple objects, or moving objects, may require multiple environment textures, each capturing the scene from a different point of view.

segments.source: ARKit generates environment textures by collecting camera imagery during the AR session.
segments.ko: ARKit generates environment textures by collecting camera imagery during the AR session.

segments.source: Because ARKit cannot see the scene in all directions, it uses machine learning to extrapolate a realistic environment from available imagery.
segments.ko: Because ARKit cannot see the scene in all directions, it uses machine learning to extrapolate a realistic environment from available imagery.

segments.source: Set Up Environment Texturing
segments.ko: Set Up Environment Texturing

segments.source: As with any AR experience, you run a session with a world tracking configuration and whatever other options you want to enable.
segments.ko: As with any AR experience, you run a session with a world tracking configuration and whatever other options you want to enable.

segments.source: (For example, this app allows you to place virtual objects on flat surfaces, so it enables horizontal plane detection.) To generate environment textures, also set the configuration’s [`ARWorldTrackingConfiguration.EnvironmentTexturing.automatic`](arworldtrackingconfiguration/environmenttexturing-swift.enum/automatic.md) property:
segments.ko: (For example, this app allows you to place virtual objects on flat surfaces, so it enables horizontal plane detection.) To generate environment textures, also set the configuration’s [`ARWorldTrackingConfiguration.EnvironmentTexturing.automatic`](arworldtrackingconfiguration/environmenttexturing-swift.enum/automatic.md) property:

segments.source:
```swift
let configuration = ARWorldTrackingConfiguration()
configuration.planeDetection = .horizontal
configuration.environmentTexturing = .automatic
sceneView.session.run(configuration)
```
segments.ko:
```swift
let configuration = ARWorldTrackingConfiguration()
configuration.planeDetection = .horizontal
configuration.environmentTexturing = .automatic
sceneView.session.run(configuration)
```

segments.source: With [`ARWorldTrackingConfiguration.EnvironmentTexturing.automatic`](arworldtrackingconfiguration/environmenttexturing-swift.enum/automatic.md) environment texturing (the default for this app) ARKit automatically chooses when and where to generate textures.
segments.ko: With [`ARWorldTrackingConfiguration.EnvironmentTexturing.automatic`](arworldtrackingconfiguration/environmenttexturing-swift.enum/automatic.md) environment texturing (the default for this app) ARKit automatically chooses when and where to generate textures.

segments.source: Render Virtual Objects with Reflection
segments.ko: Render Virtual Objects with Reflection

segments.source: Because this app also uses [`ARSCNView`](arscnview.md) to display AR content, SceneKit automatically uses the appropriate environment texture to render each virtual object in the scene.
segments.ko: Because this app also uses [`ARSCNView`](arscnview.md) to display AR content, SceneKit automatically uses the appropriate environment texture to render each virtual object in the scene.

segments.source: In SceneKit, any asset using [`SCNMaterial.LightingModel`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SceneKit/SCNMaterial/LightingModel-swift.struct) materials automatically uses *environmental lighting*.
segments.ko: In SceneKit, any asset using [`SCNMaterial.LightingModel`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SceneKit/SCNMaterial/LightingModel-swift.struct) materials automatically uses *environmental lighting*.

segments.source: With environmental lighting, the shading for each point on a surface depends on nearby light probe textures or the global lighting environment in the direction that point faces.
segments.ko: With environmental lighting, the shading for each point on a surface depends on nearby light probe textures or the global lighting environment in the direction that point faces.

segments.source: The visual effect of environment texturing depends on how you configure the properties of a physically based material.
segments.ko: The visual effect of environment texturing depends on how you configure the properties of a physically based material.

segments.source: For example, materials with a high [`roughness`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SceneKit/SCNMaterial/roughness) pick up some diffuse color from the texture, and materials with low [`roughness`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SceneKit/SCNMaterial/roughness) and high [`metalness`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SceneKit/SCNMaterial/metalness) reflect their surroundings with a mirror-like finish.
segments.ko: For example, materials with a high [`roughness`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SceneKit/SCNMaterial/roughness) pick up some diffuse color from the texture, and materials with low [`roughness`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SceneKit/SCNMaterial/roughness) and high [`metalness`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SceneKit/SCNMaterial/metalness) reflect their surroundings with a mirror-like finish.

segments.source: ![Detail screenshots showing the effect of three different environment textures on both smooth and rough virtual spheres.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/e00c718b92ef4a1fcb9c7c53292d313f/Roughness.png)
segments.ko: ![Detail screenshots showing the effect of three different environment textures on both smooth and rough virtual spheres.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/e00c718b92ef4a1fcb9c7c53292d313f/Roughness.png)

segments.source: **Note**: If your AR experience uses a rendering technology other than SceneKit, you’ll need to retrieve the generated textures yourself and determine how to use them appropriately in your shading engine.
segments.ko: **Note**: If your AR experience uses a rendering technology other than SceneKit, you’ll need to retrieve the generated textures yourself and determine how to use them appropriately in your shading engine.

segments.source: First, implement the [`session(_:didUpdate:)`](arsessiondelegate/session(_:didupdate:)-9v2kw.md) delegate method to be notified when ARKit generates environment probe textures.
segments.ko: First, implement the [`session(_:didUpdate:)`](arsessiondelegate/session(_:didupdate:)-9v2kw.md) delegate method to be notified when ARKit generates environment probe textures.

segments.source: In that method, use the [`environmentTexture`](arenvironmentprobeanchor/environmenttexture.md) property of each [`AREnvironmentProbeAnchor`](arenvironmentprobeanchor.md) object to get the texture.
segments.ko: In that method, use the [`environmentTexture`](arenvironmentprobeanchor/environmenttexture.md) property of each [`AREnvironmentProbeAnchor`](arenvironmentprobeanchor.md) object to get the texture.

segments.source: Place Environment Probes Manually for Enhanced Results
segments.ko: Place Environment Probes Manually for Enhanced Results

segments.source: Automatic environment texturing is all you need for basic environmental lighting or reflection effects.
segments.ko: Automatic environment texturing is all you need for basic environmental lighting or reflection effects.

segments.source: To render reflections more realistically, however, each reflective object needs an environment probe texture that accurately captures the area close to that object.
segments.ko: To render reflections more realistically, however, each reflective object needs an environment probe texture that accurately captures the area close to that object.

segments.source: For example, in the images above, the virtual sphere reflects the real cup when the cup is close to the sphere’s real-world position.
segments.ko: For example, in the images above, the virtual sphere reflects the real cup when the cup is close to the sphere’s real-world position.

segments.source: To more precisely define environment probes, choose [`ARWorldTrackingConfiguration.EnvironmentTexturing.manual`](arworldtrackingconfiguration/environmenttexturing-swift.enum/manual.md) environment texturing when you configure your AR session, then create your own [`AREnvironmentProbeAnchor`](arenvironmentprobeanchor.md) instance for each virtual object you want to use environmental lighting with.
segments.ko: To more precisely define environment probes, choose [`ARWorldTrackingConfiguration.EnvironmentTexturing.manual`](arworldtrackingconfiguration/environmenttexturing-swift.enum/manual.md) environment texturing when you configure your AR session, then create your own [`AREnvironmentProbeAnchor`](arenvironmentprobeanchor.md) instance for each virtual object you want to use environmental lighting with.

segments.source: Initialize each probe’s [`extent`](arenvironmentprobeanchor/extent.md) and position (using [`transform`](aranchor/transform.md) based on the size of the corresponding virtual object:
segments.ko: 각 probe의 [`extent`](arenvironmentprobeanchor/extent.md)와 위치를 초기화합니다. 해당 가상 객체 크기를 기준으로 [`transform`](aranchor/transform.md)을(를) 사용합니다.

segments.source: This code applies the rules below to optimally capture the area around each virtual object:
segments.ko: 이 코드는 각 가상 객체 주변의 영역을 최적으로 캡처하기 위해 아래 규칙을 적용합니다:

segments.source: The probe’s position should be at the top center of the virtual object, and the `y` component of its extent should be twice the height of the object. This ensures that the bottom of the probe extent aligns with the bottom of the virtual object, accurately capturing the real surface the object sits on.
segments.ko: probe의 위치는 가상 객체의 상단 중앙이어야 하며, `y` 성분은 객체 높이의 두 배여야 합니다. 이렇게 하면 probe extent의 하단이 가상 객체 하단과 맞춰져 객체가 놓인 실제 표면을 정확히 캡처합니다.

segments.source: The `x` and `z` components of the probe’s extent should be three times the width and depth of the object, ensuring that the probe captures the area beneath and around the object.
segments.ko: probe의 `x` 및 `z` 성분은 객체의 너비와 깊이의 세 배여야 하며, 이를 통해 probe가 객체 아래쪽과 주변 영역을 캡처합니다.

segments.source: ![Diagram indicating the recommended extent for an environment probe anchor around a virtual object: double the object's height and three times its width and depth, centered at the top of the object.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/d993b9291118ec512ef9d4c4f322a542/ProbeExtent.png)
segments.ko: ![가상 객체 주변의 환경 probe anchor를 위한 권장 extent를 나타내는 다이어그램: 객체 높이의 두 배, 너비와 깊이의 세 배, 객체 상단 중앙 정렬](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/d993b9291118ec512ef9d4c4f322a542/ProbeExtent.png)

segments.source: Use Environment Texturing Wisely
segments.ko: 환경 텍스처링을 신중하게 사용

segments.source: Follow these tips to keep your app’s use of environment texturing realistic and efficient:
segments.ko: 앱의 환경 텍스처링 사용을 현실감 있게 그리고 효율적으로 유지하려면 다음 팁을 따릅니다:

segments.source: **Avoid virtual content that requires accurate reflections, such as mirror-finish surfaces.**
segments.ko: **거울 마감 표면처럼 정확한 반사를 요구하는 가상 콘텐츠는 피합니다.**

segments.source: In general, an AR experience doesn’t have all the information needed to produce a perfect imitation of reality.
segments.ko: 일반적으로 AR 경험은 현실을 완전히 모방할 수 있는 모든 정보를 갖추지 못합니다.

segments.source: Good AR experiences carefully design content to hide limitations in realism, preserving the illusion that virtual objects inhabit the user’s real-world surroundings.
segments.ko: 좋은 AR 경험은 현실감의 한계를 가리는 방식으로 콘텐츠를 신중히 설계해 가상 객체가 사용자의 현실 환경에 존재한다는 인상을 유지합니다.

segments.source: ARKit environment textures don’t image the environment in all directions around the user, and don’t update in real time, so some kinds of content aren’t well suited for use in AR.
segments.ko: ARKit 환경 텍스처는 사용자를 둘러싼 모든 방향의 환경을 촬영하지 않으며 실시간으로 갱신되지 않으므로, 일부 유형의 콘텐츠는 AR에서 적합하지 않습니다.

segments.source: For example, a user encountering a virtual mirror may expect to see their own reflection.
segments.ko: 예를 들어, 가상 거울을 만나는 사용자는 자신의 반영이 나타나길 기대할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Design virtual content to use fully-reflective surfaces only in small or highly-detailed parts, and use less reflectivity in large flat surfaces.
segments.ko: 완전 반사 표면은 작거나 세부 정보가 많은 부분에서만 사용하고, 넓은 평면 표면에서는 반사도를 낮게 사용합니다.

segments.source: **Handle moving objects.**
segments.ko: **이동하는 객체를 처리합니다.**

segments.source: Rendering a virtual object with realistic reflections require an environment probe that captures a small area around that object.
segments.ko: 현실적인 반사를 렌더링하려면 해당 가상 객체 주변의 작은 영역을 캡처하는 환경 probe가 필요합니다.

segments.source: If the object changes position, the corresponding environment probe needs to change to reflect the object’s new surroundings.
segments.ko: 객체 위치가 변경되면 해당 환경 probe도 변경되어 객체의 새 주변 환경이 반영되어야 합니다.

segments.source: When manually placing probes, consider one or more of these strategies for handling objects that move:
segments.ko: 프로브를 수동으로 배치할 때는 이동하는 객체를 처리하기 위해 다음 전략 중 하나 이상을 고려합니다:

segments.source: If the path of an object’s movement is known ahead of time, create multiple environment probe anchors and place them along that path.
segments.ko: 객체의 이동 경로가 사전에 알려진 경우 여러 환경 probe anchor를 생성해 해당 경로를 따라 배치합니다.

segments.source: Create a global environment probe with an extra-large extent to fall back to when rendering objects that have moved outside the extent of nearby probes.
segments.ko: 주변 probe의 extent 범위를 벗어난 위치로 이동한 객체를 렌더링할 때 대체 사용할 수 있도록 매우 큰 extent의 글로벌 환경 probe를 생성합니다.

segments.source: After an object moves, create a new probe to capture the area around its new position, and remove environment probes associated with earlier positions.
segments.ko: 객체가 이동한 뒤에는 새 위치 주변을 캡처하는 새 probe를 생성하고 이전 위치와 연결된 환경 probe를 제거합니다.

segments.source: When you display AR content with [`ARSCNView`](arscnview.md), SceneKit automatically interpolates between environment textures for any objects that overlap the extents of multiple environment probes.
segments.ko: [`ARSCNView`](arscnview.md)로 AR 콘텐츠를 표시할 때 SceneKit은 여러 환경 probe의 extent가 겹치는 객체의 경우 자동으로 환경 텍스처를 보간합니다.

segments.source: **Don’t generate environment textures too often.**
segments.ko: **환경 텍스처를 너무 자주 생성하지 않습니다.**

segments.source: ARKit requires some time to collect camera imagery, and combining and extrapolating that imagery to produce environment textures requires computational resources.
segments.ko: ARKit는 카메라 이미지를 수집하는 데 시간이 걸리며, 그 이미지를 결합하고 외삽해 환경 텍스처를 만들려면 계산 자원이 필요합니다.

segments.source: Frequently adding new [`AREnvironmentProbeAnchor`](arenvironmentprobeanchor.md) instances to your AR session may not produce noticeable changes in the displayed scene, but does cost battery power and reduce the performance overhead available for other aspects of your AR experience.
segments.ko: 새 [`AREnvironmentProbeAnchor`](arenvironmentprobeanchor.md) 인스턴스를 AR 세션에 자주 추가해도 표시 장면의 변화가 뚜렷하지 않을 수 있지만, 배터리 전력을 소모하고 AR 경험의 다른 요소에서 사용할 수 있는 성능 오버헤드를 줄입니다.

segments.source: This app creates new environment probes whenever the user moves or resizes the virtual object, but limits such updates to occur no more often than once per second.
segments.ko: 이 앱은 사용자가 가상 객체를 이동하거나 크기를 조정할 때마다 새 환경 probe를 생성하지만, 이러한 업데이트는 초당 1회보다 자주 발생하지 않도록 제한합니다.

segments.source: (See the sample `updateEnvironmentProbe(atTime:)` function.)
segments.ko: (샘플 `updateEnvironmentProbe(atTime:)` 함수를 참조합니다.)

segments.source: **Avoid abrupt transitions between different environment textures.**
segments.ko: **서로 다른 환경 텍스처 간의 급격한 전환을 피합니다.**

segments.source: With [`ARSCNView`](arscnview.md), if the environment probe texture(s) affecting an object change (either because the object moves or because a new texture becomes available for its current position), SceneKit automatically uses a short fade-in animation to transition to the new result.
segments.ko: [`ARSCNView`](arscnview.md)에서 환경 텍스처가 변경되면(객체 이동 또는 해당 위치에 새 텍스처가 사용 가능해진 경우), SceneKit은 짧은 페이드 인 애니메이션을 사용해 새 결과로 자동 전환합니다.

segments.source: Depending on what environment textures are in use before and after the transition, that change may be jarring to the user.
segments.ko: 전환 전후에 사용되는 환경 텍스처의 내용에 따라 이 변경이 사용자에게 거칠게 느껴질 수 있습니다.

segments.source: To avoid unrealistic transitions, this sample app waits until the first environment texture becomes available before allowing the user to place virtual content.
segments.ko: 현실감 없는 전환을 피하기 위해 이 샘플 앱은 첫 번째 환경 텍스처가 사용 가능해질 때까지 사용자가 가상 콘텐츠를 배치하도록 허용하지 않습니다.

segments.source: In automatic mode, as soon as the session begins, ARKit automatically begins generating a fallback environment texture covering a large area.
segments.ko: 자동 모드에서는 세션 시작 즉시 ARKit가 넓은 영역을 덮는 fallback 환경 텍스처 생성을 자동으로 시작합니다.

segments.source: In manual mode, the app creates its own fallback environment probe.
segments.ko: (샘플 `updateSceneEnvironmentProbe(for:)` 함수를 참조합니다.) 이 환경 텍스처가 사용 가능해질 때까지 기다리면 가상 객체가 항상 세션에 적합한 환경을 반영합니다.

segments.source: (See the sample `updateSceneEnvironmentProbe(for:)` function.) Waiting until this environment texture is available ensures that virtual objects always reflect an environment appropriate to the session.
segments.ko: (See the sample `updateSceneEnvironmentProbe(for:)` function.) Waiting until this environment texture is available ensures that virtual objects always reflect an environment appropriate to the session.

segments.source: Alternatively, your app may include a static environment-map texture for use as a fallback when environment texturing is not available (for example, to support earlier iOS versions).
segments.ko: 환경 텍스처링을 사용할 수 없을 때(예: 이전 iOS 버전 지원을 위해) 대체용으로 정적 환경 맵 텍스처를 앱에 포함할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: In this case, try to design or select a texture that appears realistic in a wide variety of situations.
segments.ko: 이 경우 다양한 상황에서 사실적으로 보이는 텍스처를 설계하거나 선택합니다.
